description: Read a person's own Vibes as an app the person approved (D12): GET /api/v1/vibes/me with a person-delegated app token answers billing.vibes-wallet@1 — the Vibes to spend, the creator payable that can be cashed out (never into Balance) and today's bits_per_usd. The app sees only the person who approved it, never another person's Vibes.
